_leia_me: Sugestoes de playlist para treinar, que viajam com o site. Sao apenas LINKS publicos: o RiseONE nao hospeda nem redistribui musica, e nao tem vinculo com o Spotify. Para trocar: entre no app como administrador, abra Ajustes > Preferencias > Musica do treino e use o botao de baixar musicas.json.
_readme: Workout playlist suggestions shipped with the site. These are public LINKS only: RiseONE does not host or redistribute music and has no affiliation with Spotify. To change them: sign in as administrator, open Settings > Preferences > Workout music and use the download musicas.json button.
